name: hypd-meta-ads
description: Analyze connected Meta ad accounts: campaign, ad set and ad performance, creatives, audiences, pixels, catalogs and Meta's recommendations.

interface.longDescription:
HYPD.AI Social Ads works with authorized Meta ad accounts to help advertisers, agencies, ecommerce teams and paid-social specialists understand performance across Facebook and Instagram, find wasted spend and decide what to change next.

Use it to:

• Discover the ad accounts you connected, confirm the right one, and review its campaigns, ad sets and ads with their objectives, budgets, bidding and delivery status.

• Report spend, impressions, reach, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPM, results, cost per result, conversions, conversion value and ROAS for any date range, at account, campaign, ad set or ad level, with breakdowns such as age, gender, placement, platform and country.

• Compare periods to see whether a change comes from costs, reach, engagement or conversion rates.

• Flag campaigns, ad sets and ads that spend without results, exceed a target cost per result or fall below a target ROAS.

• Open ad creatives, compare how they perform, and spot fatigue in frequency, CTR and cost trends.

• Review custom audiences, pixels and datasets, and look up targeting options.

• Read Meta's own recommendations for an account and its change history, to explain sudden shifts.

• Check product catalogs, product sets, feed rules and catalog diagnostics behind catalog ads.

• List Facebook and Instagram Pages and their lead forms.

• Look up Meta's advertising policies and the definition of any Meta metric.

HYPD.AI is read-only: it analyzes the connected ad accounts and recommends improvements, but does not change campaigns, ad sets, ads, budgets, bids, audiences or account settings.

HYPD.AI is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. Meta, Facebook and Instagram are trademarks of Meta Platforms, Inc.
capabilities: Report Meta campaign, ad set and ad performance for any date range
Find ad sets and ads that spend without results
Open ad creatives and compare how they perform
Review custom audiences, pixels and datasets
Read Meta's recommendations and the account's change history
Check product catalogs and their diagnostics
defaultPrompt: Use $hypd-get-started to help me get started with HYPD.AI Social Ads.

positive.description: Discover an ad account and inspect its campaigns.
positive.prompt: List my connected Meta ad accounts. Ask me to choose one if needed, then show its campaigns with objective, budget and status.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an account_id copied verbatim from discovery, in its act_ form. Show the actual campaigns, objectives, budgets and statuses, and ask for a choice when several accounts are connected.

positive.description: Report campaign performance for a date range.
positive.prompt: For the last 30 complete days, show spend, results and cost per result by campaign, then the daily trend over the last 7 complete days for the campaign with the most spend.
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit inclusive YYYY-MM-DD dates and the returned metrics only, with one fb_insights call per day for the daily trend. Report amounts in the account's currency as returned, and do not invent results or conversions that the report does not contain.

positive.description: Drill into an ad set and its creative.
positive.prompt: Find the ad set with the highest cost per result in the last 30 complete days, list its ads and open the creative of its top-spending ad.
positive.tools_triggered: init, fb_list_ad_accounts, fb_insights, fb_get_adsets, fb_get_ads, fb_get_creative
positive.expected_behavior: Rank ad sets from the report, use the returned ad set and ad ids for the reads, and describe the creative's actual text, call to action and media. Do not suggest that any change was made.

positive.prompt: Show the pixels and datasets on my selected ad account and its custom audiences, and point out any that look inactive.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the actual pixels, datasets and audiences with their available status and activity fields, such as when each pixel last fired. When event counts cannot be read, say so instead of calling a pixel inactive. Do not create or edit tracking or audiences.

positive.description: Explain recent changes with Meta's own data.
positive.prompt: Show Meta's recommendations for my selected ad account and what changed in the account in the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Present Meta's recommendations and the account's change history as returned, with dates and the objects they concern. Do not apply any recommendation.

negative.description: Do not make campaign or budget changes.
negative.prompt: Pause my worst ad set and raise the budget of my best campaign by 20 percent.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this plugin to execute edits. Explain that it analyzes the account read-only and cannot pause ad sets or change budgets; it may still support a separately requested analysis.

negative.description: Do not create campaigns or ads.
negative.prompt: Create a new Meta campaign with a lead form and two new ads.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke read tools as if they created anything. Explain that creating campaigns, ads and lead forms is not supported.

negative.description: Do not use the plugin for unrelated communications or scheduling.
negative.prompt: Email my colleague and add a meeting to my calendar tomorrow.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this plugin for email or calendar operations; these capabilities are outside its surface.

review.commerce_description: Provides read-only advertising analysis; does not sell products, accept payments or complete purchases.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only analysis of connected Meta ad accounts on facebookads.hypd.ai, with a get-started skill that shows new users their first steps.
